semiconductor_relevance: Low — the company primarily manufactures electric panels and switchgear, which are not directly related to semiconductor production.
summary: Advance Panels & Switchgears P Ltd specializes in the manufacturing of various electric panels and switchboards, including low tension (LT) panels, high tension (HT) panels, and motor control centers. While their products are essential for electrical distribution and control, they do not directly supply semiconductor materials or equipment.
